worked_solution:
The four fundamental subspaces of a matrix $A$ can be schematically visualized, as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14100016/assets/889b83fadd26b377c4dd34143c9b16541630c04e90de3d9b005e7147ead75ad5.png)

In our case, we are given that $m=2,$ $n=4,$ and $m-r=1.$ 

Substituting $m=2$ into $m-r=1,$ we can find the rank of $A:$

$$
(2)-r=1\,⟹\,r=1
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{dim}(\text{Col}(A)) & =r=1.\end{aligned}
$$
